svg.title: AWS ETL resource DAG
svg.desc:
AWS ETL resource DAG Separate Lambda extractors, explicit AWS resources, and nested account boundaries. Solid lines: data and metadata. Dashed lines: mwaa task control.
Blocks, left to right: - ETL orchestration (Amazon MWAA) - API extractor (AWS Lambda) - SaaS extractor (AWS Lambda) - Database extractor (AWS Lambda) - Raw landing (Amazon S3) - Transform + validate (AWS Glue) - Table metadata (Glue Data Catalog) - Curated Parquet (Amazon S3) - Analytics SQL (Amazon Athena) - Business dashboards (Amazon QuickSight) Groups: - Lambda extraction tasks: API extractor, SaaS extractor, Database extractor - Curated lake + catalog: Curated Parquet, Table metadata - Analytics and visualization: Analytics SQL, Business dashboards - AWS account (Logical service boundaries; networking and IAM omitted): API extractor, SaaS extractor, Database extractor, Curated Parquet, Table metadata, Analytics SQL, Business dashboards, ETL orchestration, Raw landing, Transform + validate Lines: - API extractor -> Raw landing - SaaS extractor -> Raw landing - Database extractor -> Raw landing - Raw landing -> Transform + validate, labeled "read" - Transform + validate -> Curated Parquet, labeled "Parquet" - Curated Parquet -> Analytics SQL, labeled "query" - Analytics SQL -> Business dashboards, labeled "results" - Curated Parquet -> Table metadata, labeled "register" - Table metadata -> Analytics SQL, labeled "schema" - ETL orchestration -> API extractor (dashed line) - ETL orchestration -> SaaS extractor (dashed line) - ETL orchestration -> Database extractor (dashed line) - ETL orchestration -> Transform + validate, labeled "after extraction" (dashed line) Note: Illustrative workload. Fictional account; no deployed resources Dashed arrows: orchestration
